description: Fetch the text of one section of a Pakistani federal Act, e.g. section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code 1860 (punishment of qatl-i-amd) or section 497 CrPC. Give act (title words like "Penal Code") or act_id from pk_search_acts, and the section number. Read live from the Ministry of Law and Justice's published copy.

act.description: Act title words, e.g. "Penal Code" (first match is used). Prefer act_id when ambiguous.
